student_success.utils.validation module

safe_parse_tuple(val)[source]

Robustly parses list/tuple-like values from strings or native sequences, preserving structure and replacing invalid entries (e.g., NaN, None) with None.

Parameters:

val (str | tuple | list) – Input to parse.

Returns:

List of parsed values, preserving positional structure.

Return type:

list

validate_columns(df_columns, required_columns)[source]

Validates that all required columns are present in a DataFrame.

Parameters:

  • df_columns (iterable) – A list-like object (e.g., df.columns) containing the column names from a DataFrame.

  • required_columns (list of str) – A list of column names expected to be present in the DataFrame.

Raises:

ValueError – If any of the required columns are missing, a ValueError is raised listing them.
